_comment: Ground truth for the RO4 evaluation.
One entry per curated regression-inducing pull request. 'expected' lists the
features that genuinely regressed, established by cross-referencing the diff,
the linked issue report and the fix commit, as described in proposal section 5.3.
Feature names must match the feature_name values in your Feature Registry
exactly, because scoring compares them as strings.
risk_level is the label a correct analysis should produce:
High   - the feature's own code area changed directly
Medium - the feature depends indirectly on changed code
Low    - the overlap is minor or unlikely to cause a regression
A feature absent from 'expected' is treated as correctly omitted, so any
prediction naming it counts as a false positive.
The entry below is an example of the required shape. Replace it with your
15 to 20 curated pull requests before running a full evaluation.

pull_requests.note: Fixes a regression in ExcludeIf by requiring a Closure rather than any callable.
